inputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.constructor.storage
inputs.description: The Durable Object storage instance retained by the adapter for synchronous SQL record access and alarm operations.

inputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.saveHost.record
inputs.description: The host record serialized into the fixed `host` key. Its fields are stored as JSON without transformation.

inputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.device.deviceId
inputs.description: The device ID appended unchanged to the `device:` storage key when reading a device. The implementation applies no validation or normalization.

inputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.saveDevice.record
inputs.description: The device record serialized under `device:<record.deviceId>`. Its `deviceId` field determines the key, and the record is stored as JSON.

inputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.removeDevice.deviceId
inputs.description: The device ID appended unchanged to the `device:` key to delete. If that key is absent, the operation leaves storage unchanged; the implementation applies no validation or normalization.

inputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.pairing.pairingId
inputs.description: The pairing ID appended unchanged to the `pairing:` storage key when reading a pairing. The implementation applies no validation or normalization.

inputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.savePairing.record
inputs.description: The pairing record serialized under `pairing:<record.pairingId>`. Its `pairingId` field determines the key, and the record is stored as JSON.

inputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.removePairing.pairingId
inputs.description: The pairing ID appended unchanged to the `pairing:` key to delete. If that key is absent, the operation leaves storage unchanged; the implementation applies no validation or normalization.

inputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.rate.bucket
inputs.description: The rate bucket appended unchanged to the `rate:` storage key when reading a rate record. The adapter does not validate or normalize the bucket.

inputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.saveRate.bucket
inputs.description: The rate bucket appended unchanged to the `rate:` key under which the supplied rate record is stored. The adapter does not validate or normalize the bucket.

inputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.saveRate.record
inputs.description: The rate record serialized as JSON under the key selected by the supplied bucket.

inputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.alarmAt.time
inputs.description: The time passed to `setAlarm`; when it is undefined, the adapter deletes the alarm instead. The implementation does not validate or transform numeric values.

outputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.host
outputs.description: The stored host record, or undefined when the `host` key has no value or the records table has not been created. Stored JSON is parsed into the record type.

outputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.saveHost
outputs.description: No return value; serializes the supplied host record and upserts it at the fixed `host` key.

outputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.device
outputs.description: The device record stored at `device:<deviceId>`, or undefined when that key is absent or the records table has not been created. Stored JSON is parsed into the record type.

outputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.devices
outputs.description: All device records, returned in storage-key order. Returns an empty array when the records table has not been created or no device keys exist.

outputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.saveDevice
outputs.description: No return value; serializes the device record and upserts it at `device:<record.deviceId>`.

outputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.removeDevice
outputs.description: No return value; deletes the `device:<deviceId>` key when the records table exists.

outputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.pairing
outputs.description: The pairing record stored at `pairing:<pairingId>`, or undefined when that key is absent or the records table has not been created. Stored JSON is parsed into the record type.

outputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.pairings
outputs.description: All pairing records, returned in storage-key order. Returns an empty array when the records table has not been created or no pairing keys exist.

outputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.savePairing
outputs.description: No return value; serializes the pairing record and upserts it at `pairing:<record.pairingId>`.

outputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.removePairing
outputs.description: No return value; deletes the `pairing:<pairingId>` key when the records table exists.

outputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.rate
outputs.description: The rate record stored at `rate:<bucket>`, or undefined when that key is absent or the records table has not been created. Stored JSON is parsed into the record type.

outputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.saveRate
outputs.description: No return value; serializes the rate record and upserts it at `rate:<bucket>`.

outputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.alarmAt
outputs.description: Resolves after deleting the alarm when time is undefined, or after passing the supplied time to `setAlarm`.

outputs.name: HostStorageAdapter.clear
outputs.description: Resolves after deleting the alarm and all stored records, then resets the adapter's table-created cache.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: A read or list operation throws this when stored value text is not valid JSON.
